spec.title: Cairn account registration and onboarding use cases
spec.replaces: Registration portion of UC-1 to UC-13
spec.status: Approved for build. User-facing copy pending legal review.
instructions_for_claude_code: Compare the existing registration code against every use case below and revise it to match. Report any use case the current code already satisfies, partially satisfies, or does not implement.
Treat the data_requirements section as the target shape. Adapt names to the existing schema and migrations rather than duplicating tables that already serve the same purpose.
User-facing strings in copy must be used verbatim. Do not rewrite them. Store them so they can be versioned and replaced after legal review.
Every flow must follow the conversational principles: acknowledge first, one question per screen, offer rather than demand, and always leave the user a clear next action.
Items marked legal_review must be implemented as written but left easy to change. Do not treat them as final.
Do not use em dashes in any user-facing copy.

conversational: Acknowledge the person's situation before asking anything.
Ask one question at a time.
Offer next steps rather than demanding information.
Never leave the user without a clear next action.
principles.audience: Write and design for the least tech-comfortable user: surviving spouse, adult child acting as executor, power of attorney, or professional fiduciary.
accessibility: Never rely on color alone to carry meaning.
Plain language, roughly 8th grade reading level for summaries.
Buttons carry text labels, not icons alone.
safety_invariants: The crisis protocol, AI disclosure, attorney referral rules, and citation requirements apply in every flow and cannot be changed by any setting, including personality.
Cairn never presents itself as a human, attorney, therapist, counselor, or medical professional.

decisions.decision: Offer Google, Sign in with Apple, and email. Apple is required on iOS whenever Google sign-in is offered.
Free trial is 4 weeks, defined as exactly 28 days. User-facing copy always says 28 days.
The 28-day clock starts when the user creates their first case, not at account creation.
One trial per account. Creating additional cases does not restart the clock.
On day 29, counted from first case creation, the account becomes read-only. No data is deleted and nothing is charged. The user can still view records, subscribe, or delete the account.
No payment method is collected during signup or the trial.
Cairn never uses user data or decedent data for marketing or advertising, and never sells or shares it for ads.
Users can delete their account and personal data in-app at any time. Deactivation alone does not satisfy this.

Signup includes an acknowledgment that Cairn is an AI guide, not a human, not an attorney, not a therapist, and will always refer the user to one when the situation calls for it. The notice references California SB 243.
Passwordless magic link is the default for email accounts. If passwords are supported, follow NIST SP 800-63B-4.

An account that has not finished onboarding (status pending_onboarding) is deleted 90 days after it was created, with its consent records (UC-REG-10). The period for accounts that finish onboarding but never create a case (UC-REG-13) is not set.

For the MVP: a second sign-in is added only after signing in with a method the account already has. One sign-in per method (at most three). The account email stays the one from the original sign-in. Only methods added later can be removed. Never linked automatically (UC-REG-05).
Naming a death by suicide is a loss, not a crisis. It does not pause sign-up or start the crisis plan. The user's own risk signals still do (UC-REG-14, card 26).

onboarding_sequence: UC-REG-02, UC-REG-03, or UC-REG-04 Create account (UC-REG-05 if the account exists)
UC-REG-07 Privacy Policy and Terms acknowledgment
Hand-off to case creation (trial clock starts when the first case is saved)

copy.welcome_acknowledgment: We're sorry you're here. Cairn will walk with you one step at a time.
copy.welcome_not_ready_link: Not ready to sign up? See what the first weeks look like.
copy.oauth_cancelled: No problem. You can choose another way whenever you're ready.
copy.email_check_inbox: Check your inbox for a link from Cairn. It may take a minute.
copy.account_exists: It looks like you already have a Cairn account. Last time you signed in with {provider}.
copy.age_under_18: Cairn is built for adults handling these tasks. If you're helping a family member, they can create an account.
copy.privacy_terms_summary: Your privacy matters, especially right now. Cairn never uses your information, or information about the person who died, for marketing or advertising. We do not sell it or share it for ads. We use it only to help you with the steps in front of you. You can delete your account and your information at any time from Settings.
copy.privacy_terms_checkbox: I have read and agree to the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.
copy.trial_summary: Cairn is free for 28 days, and we will not ask for a card. Your 28 days begin when you start your first case, so nothing counts down while you get settled. After 28 days, a subscription is needed to keep adding and updating your tasks. If you do not subscribe, your account becomes read-only on day 29. Nothing is deleted and nothing is charged. We will remind you before your free time ends.
copy.trial_checkbox: I understand that 28 days after I start my first case, I will need a subscription to keep using Cairn fully.
copy.ai_notice: Before we begin, an important notice. Cairn is an artificial intelligence (AI) guide. It is not a human. It is not an attorney and cannot give legal advice. It is not a therapist, counselor, or medical professional. Cairn helps you organize the steps after a death and points you to official instructions, and it can make mistakes. Whenever your situation calls for an attorney, a therapist, or crisis support, Cairn will always tell you and point you to one. If you are in crisis, you can call or text 988, or chat at 988lifeline.org, any time.
copy.ai_notice_legal: This notice is provided consistent with the disclosure requirements of California Senate Bill 243 (2025), which requires that you be told clearly that you are interacting with an artificially generated assistant and not a human.
copy.ai_checkbox: I understand Cairn is an AI guide, not a human, attorney, or therapist, and is not a substitute for professional advice.
copy.decline_acknowledgment: That's okay. You can't use Cairn without agreeing, but you're not stuck.
copy.preferred_name_question: What would you like me to call you?
copy.personality_question: How would you like me to talk with you? You can change this anytime.
copy.resume_onboarding: Welcome back. You were almost done. Let's pick up where you left off.
copy.crisis_resource: You can call or text 988, or chat at 988lifeline.org, any time.
copy.case_created_trial_start: Your case is set up. Your 28 free days start today and end on {trial_end_date}. We will remind you before then.
copy.trial_reminder_day_21: Your free time with Cairn ends in 7 days, on {trial_end_date}. Nothing will be charged. If you'd like to keep going, you can choose a subscription whenever you're ready.
copy.trial_reminder_day_27: Your free time with Cairn ends tomorrow, {trial_end_date}. Your information stays safe either way. After tomorrow your account becomes read-only until you subscribe.
copy.read_only_banner: Your free 28 days have ended. Everything you've done is saved and you can still view it. To keep adding and updating tasks, choose a subscription.

data_requirements.note: Suggested shape. Map onto the existing relational schema and RLS policies. Field names are illustrative.

fields.email: string, verified. May be an Apple private relay address.
fields.voice: enum: steady_direct | warm_patient | brisk_businesslike | plain_practical, default steady_direct. The voices are defined in voices/manifest.yaml. Replaces personality (1.2.0).
fields.onboarding_step: enum tracking the last completed step, used by UC-REG-13
fields.status: enum: pending_onboarding | active_no_case | trial_active | read_only | subscribed | pending_deletion
fields.trial_started_at: timestamp, nullable. Set once, when the first case is created. Never reset.

rules: trial_started_at is written in the same transaction that creates the account's first case, and only if it is null.
Account is read-only when status is not subscribed and current time is at or after trial_ends_at.
Display trial_end_date in the user's local time zone.
Read-only means cases and tasks can be viewed but not created or edited. Account deletion and subscription remain available.

fields.document_version: string, version of the policy or copy shown
fields.auth_provider: enum, method used at time of consent

rules: Append-only. Never update or delete a consent record except as part of full account deletion.
If a document version changes, the user is asked to acknowledge the new version on next sign-in.
Schedule trial reminders at trial_started_at plus 21 days and plus 27 days.
Reminders go by email and in-app. Email must work for Apple private relay addresses.

use_cases.title: Arrive at the welcome screen
main_flow: Show copy.welcome_acknowledgment before any request.
Show three equally weighted choices: Continue with Google, Continue with Apple, Continue with email.
Show a link: Already have an account? Sign in.
Show copy.welcome_not_ready_link, which opens the public journey map.
postconditions: User has chosen a sign-in method or left with a next step.
acceptance_criteria: No personal data is requested on this screen.
All buttons meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast and 44x44 pt minimum size.
Nothing depends on color alone.

use_cases.title: Create an account with Google
main_flow: Verify the Google ID token server-side.
Create the account with email, auth_provider google, and provider_subject_id.
If Google shares a name, keep it only to pre-fill UC-REG-11.
Continue to UC-REG-06.

steps: Return to UC-REG-01 and show copy.oauth_cancelled.

alternate_flows.condition: Email already belongs to a Cairn account.

acceptance_criteria: Token verification happens on the server, never only on the client.

use_cases.title: Create an account with Apple
use_cases.trigger: User completes Sign in with Apple.
main_flow: Verify the Apple identity token server-side.
Accept either the real email or a Hide My Email relay address.
Create the account with auth_provider apple.
If Apple shares a name, keep it only to pre-fill UC-REG-11.
Continue to UC-REG-06.

steps: Return to UC-REG-01 and show copy.oauth_cancelled.

alternate_flows.condition: Email already belongs to a Cairn account.

acceptance_criteria: Cairn's outbound email domain is registered with Apple's Private Email Relay Service and authenticated with SPF and DKIM.
Verification, trial reminder, and support emails are confirmed to deliver to relay addresses.
Sending volume stays under the relay limit of 100 emails per day per address.

use_cases.title: Create an account with email
main_flow: Ask only for the email address.
Send a magic sign-in link and show copy.email_check_inbox.
User taps the link. Mark the email verified and create the account with auth_provider email.
Continue to UC-REG-06.

steps: Show a single Send a new link button.
Offer Resend and a prompt to check the spelling of the email.

alternate_flows.condition: Email already belongs to a Cairn account.

postconditions: Account exists with a verified email and status pending_onboarding.
acceptance_criteria: Magic link expires after 15 minutes and is single use.

If passwords are offered: minimum 15 characters when the password is the only factor, allow at least 64 characters, no composition rules, screen against breached-password lists, no forced periodic rotation.

use_cases.title: Account already exists or user signs in a different way
preconditions: Submitted email or provider identity matches an existing account.
use_cases.trigger: Sign-up attempt with an existing identity.
main_flow: Show copy.account_exists with the provider used previously.
Offer that provider as the primary button.

alternate_flows.condition: User wants to link a second sign-in method.
steps: Require sign-in with the original method before linking.

postconditions: User is signed in to the existing account or directed to the correct method.
acceptance_criteria: Never auto-link accounts across providers without verification.
Support has a documented path to merge an Apple relay account with a real-email account.

use_cases.title: Confirm adult age
main_flow: Ask copy.age_question with Yes and No.
On Yes, set age_confirmed_at and continue to UC-REG-07.

steps: Link to the public journey map and support resources.

postconditions: age_confirmed_at is set, or onboarding stops.
acceptance_criteria: No further personal data is collected from a user who answers No.
legal_review: Confirm age gate approach and handling of under-18 answers.

use_cases.title: Acknowledge Privacy Policy and Terms of Use
main_flow: Show copy.privacy_terms_summary with links to the full Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.
Name the third-party AI provider in the summary or linked policy.
Show an unchecked checkbox with copy.privacy_terms_checkbox.
Enable Continue only when checked.
Write a consent_record with consent_type privacy_terms.
acceptance_criteria: Checkbox is never pre-checked.
Consent record stores document version, timestamp, auth provider, and client.
Statement that data is never used for marketing or advertising appears in the summary.
Third-party AI data sharing is disclosed before any data is sent to it.
legal_review: Align the no marketing or advertising promise with the marketing section of CAIRN-POL-PRIV-01.
Require the same commitment in the AI provider and every subprocessor contract.

use_cases.title: Acknowledge the free trial and subscription
main_flow: Show copy.trial_summary.
Show an unchecked checkbox with copy.trial_checkbox.
Write a consent_record with consent_type trial_terms.
Do not start the trial clock here.
postconditions: trial_terms consent recorded. trial_started_at remains null.
acceptance_criteria: No payment method is requested anywhere in signup.
trial_started_at is set only when the first case is created, in the same transaction.
trial_ends_at equals trial_started_at plus 28 days.
Creating a second case never changes trial_started_at.
copy.case_created_trial_start is shown when the first case is saved, with the end date in the user's local time zone.
Reminders fire at day 21 and day 27 using copy.trial_reminder_day_21 and copy.trial_reminder_day_27.
At or after trial_ends_at without a subscription, status becomes read_only and copy.read_only_banner is shown. No data is deleted and nothing is charged.
The later subscription screen shows price, renewal term, what is included, and how to cancel before purchase.

use_cases.title: Acknowledge Cairn's use of AI and its limits
main_flow: Show copy.ai_notice followed by copy.ai_notice_legal.
Show an unchecked checkbox with copy.ai_checkbox.
Write a consent_record with consent_type ai_notice.
acceptance_criteria: copy.ai_persistent_label is visible in every chat view after this step.
The notice states Cairn is not a human, not an attorney, and not a therapist, and that it will always refer the user to one when needed.
988 crisis resource appears in the notice.
legal_review: Confirm whether Cairn is a companion chatbot under SB 243 or falls under its exemption for bots limited to customer service or productivity functions.
Confirm SB 243 citation wording and whether to add a statute section number.

use_cases.title: User declines an acknowledgment
preconditions: User is on UC-REG-07, UC-REG-08, or UC-REG-09.
use_cases.trigger: User taps I'm not sure, or tries to leave without checking the box.
main_flow: Show copy.decline_acknowledgment.
Offer: read the full document again, view the public journey map, contact support.
acceptance_criteria: The user is never left without a next action.
Pending accounts and their consent records are deleted 90 days after the account was created (D-2026-10-05-R1).
legal_review: Add the 90-day pending-account cleanup (D-2026-10-05-R1) to the retention schedule.

use_cases.title: Provide a preferred name
main_flow: Ask copy.preferred_name_question. Pre-fill from Google or Apple if a name was shared.
Offer optional copy.pronunciation_link.
Save preferred_name and optional name_pronunciation.
acceptance_criteria: Legal name is not collected here. It is collected at case creation only when needed.
Pre-filled name must be confirmed by the user, never saved silently.

use_cases.title: Choose a Cairn personality
main_flow: Ask copy.personality_question.
Show every voice in voices/manifest.yaml (Steady and Direct, Warm & Patient, Brisk and Businesslike, Plain and Practical) with its tagline and its reference response to the same situation.
Offer copy.personality_default_button, which selects the manifest's default_voice (steady_direct).
Save the voice on the account.
Confirm in the chosen voice using the preferred name, then hand off to case creation.
acceptance_criteria: The voice can be changed anytime in Settings.
The voice changes tone only. It never alters the crisis protocol, AI disclosure, attorney referrals, or citations. Those live in voices/core.md, which applies to every voice.
Voices do not use human first names.
legal_review: Review personality design against SB 243 human-likeness concerns.

use_cases.title: Leave and resume onboarding
preconditions: onboarding_step is not complete, or status is active_no_case.
main_flow: Show copy.resume_onboarding.
Resume at the first incomplete step.
If onboarding is complete but no case exists, guide the user gently to case creation.

alternate_flows.condition: A policy or copy version changed since the user acknowledged it.
steps: Ask the user to acknowledge the new version before continuing.

postconditions: User continues from where they left off.
acceptance_criteria: Acknowledgments are not repeated unless the version changed.
No free days are used before the first case is created.
legal_review: Set the cleanup period for accounts that complete signup but never create a case.

use_cases.title: User shows signs of distress during signup
preconditions: User is anywhere in the signup flow.
use_cases.trigger: Distress signals in any free-text input, or the user taps copy.need_a_moment_control.
main_flow: Stop the task flow completely.
Acknowledge what the user said without steering back to signup.
Show copy.crisis_resource.
Wait with no timers, nudges, or reminders.
postconditions: Signup is paused. Progress is saved.
acceptance_criteria: copy.need_a_moment_control is visible on every onboarding screen.
Behavior matches the crisis plan on Trello card 26 and is identical across all personalities.

use_cases.title: Delete account (launch requirement, lifecycle)
preconditions: User is signed in, in any status including read_only.
use_cases.trigger: User chooses Delete account in Settings.
main_flow: Explain plainly what will be deleted.
Ask for confirmation.
Delete the account and personal data according to the retention schedule.
For Apple accounts, revoke tokens through the Sign in with Apple REST API.
postconditions: Account and personal data deleted. Tokens revoked.
acceptance_criteria: Delete account is easy to find in Settings.
Deactivation alone does not satisfy this use case.
